Option B (Sydney window)
- Wed Dec 15, 11:00–11:45 AEST/AEDT (Sydney — note DST: UTC+11 in Dec)

Option C (Late US-friendly, next-day for APAC)
- Tue Dec 14, 17:00–17:45 PST (US West, UTC-8) — this is Wed morning in APAC (see conversions above)

If you prefer I can create invites in Japan local time (JST) to remove ambiguity. I also included Marissa (AE) and Soojin (SE) on cc for capacity.

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the options. Apologies if this is a dumb question, but I'm getting mixed signals between the calendar invite I received and your email. The invite in my calendar shows "Tue, Dec 14 09:00" (my calendar converted it to local time) while your email lists Wed Dec 15 for the same slot. Our team is small and we want to avoid a no-show. Could you confirm: are the times you listed anchored to the timezone in parentheses (e.g., 09:00 JST on Dec 15) or to your local time in the invite?

Also, I noticed you listed PST for Option C — with US daylight saving differences it can be tricky. For our team it's easiest if you send invites explicitly as "Asia/Tokyo (JST)" so the date doesn't roll over unexpectedly.

Best,

If that works, I’ll send the new invite in the next 10 minutes.
